newsitem.title: UK: LME copper eases in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper eases in late trading.

text.p: LME copper drifted lower in late inter-office trading on Thursday evening after chalking up fresh highs.
Three months copper was indicated at $2,507/10 per tonne at 1800 GMT, down from an afternoon kerb close of $2,526 and the day's high of $2,530.
Analysts said the market was extremely overbought with an 14-day RSI of 80 percent, the highest in over a year, and needed to take a breather.
The market may be drawn to fill a gap between Thursday's low of $2,498 and Tuesday's high of $2,495, they added.
The other metals were little changed.
